title: Choose TwelveWeek’s new world
question: The redesign makes Home an immediate next-workout surface and rebuilds every deeper interaction in one visual grammar. Choose the world that should govern both interface and behavior.

options.label: Control Course
options.lineage: orienteering control maps, waterproof route cards, and enamel trail blazes
options.thesis: The 12-week plan becomes a navigable course: one unmistakable checkpoint now, the route always visible.
options.viewport: A cropped route fills Home; TODAY sits inside one blaze-orange checkpoint with a large Start action, while passed and future controls remain visible as context.
options.risk: Contour and route detail must stay subordinate to workout labels or the metaphor becomes navigation noise.

options.label: Midnight Training Line
options.lineage: metropolitan rail maps fired as midnight-blue enamel murals
options.thesis: Every week becomes a line of stations; the next workout is the lit interchange.
options.case: Wins route clarity; loses training identification because its commuter grammar feels borrowed rather than native.
options.viewport: The current week corridor occupies Home at full scale, with completed stations behind, the next workout enlarged, and one direct Begin journey action.
options.risk: A dark transit skin could feel too close to the discarded dark UI unless the enamel mapping truly owns every screen.

options.label: Signal Bench
options.lineage: CRT oscilloscopes, etched graticules, and detented laboratory controls
options.thesis: The current interval locks into focus while progress traces across a rigorously measured field.
options.case: Wins at-a-glance timer focus; loses product clarity because TwelveWeek has no live performance signal.
options.viewport: Home behaves like an armed instrument: the next session is the primary channel, completion becomes a stable trace, and Begin is the single trigger.
options.risk: The lab language can overstate measurement and make simple checklists feel technical.

options.label: Load / Release
options.lineage: tensegrity structures built from carbon struts and tension cord
options.thesis: Training becomes a structure that visibly stabilizes as each part of the session is completed.
options.case: Fuses poorly because a force network obscures the product’s fundamentally linear workout sequence.
options.viewport: A vertical structure maps the program; the current node anchors a factual next-workout panel and completed sections pull the route into balance.
options.risk: The structural metaphor may demand explanation at exactly the moment the user needs immediate action.

canonCard.label: Material fitness standard
canonCard.thesis: A familiar dashboard, progress ring, week cards, and guided player executed at high Material 3 craft.
canonCard.viewport: A progress summary sits above the next workout card, with predictable tabs for Plan, Train, and Progress.
canonCard.risk: Immediately usable, but unlikely to feel ownable or meaningfully reimagined.
